config.note: boundaries from code constants (pre-registered), NOT from the persisted dict — see module docstring

treatments.label: Champion — the live desk policy
treatments.rationale: leader's call at >=0.62 confidence, every biddable window

treatments.label: M8 · regime gate
treatments.rationale: stand down when trailing-20 market accuracy < 0.62

treatments.label: M1 · calibrated gate
treatments.rationale: gate and side taken from p_cal, not raw p_up

treatments.label: M9 · Underdog (cheap bids only)
treatments.rationale: only enter at ask <= 51c, where break-even is far below 50%

treatments.label: M2+M8 · both vetoes
treatments.rationale: stand down on knife-edge OR low-predictability regime

treatments.label: M3 · Fixed-Share leader
treatments.rationale: leader by multiplicative expert weights, not a 10-bet streak

treatments.label: M3+M8 · Fixed-Share + regime gate
treatments.rationale: the expert-weighted leader, standing down in bad regimes

treatments.label: Champion at REAL fills (execution baseline)
treatments.rationale: the desk's actual entries at the ask it actually paid

treatments.label: M10 · execution guard
treatments.rationale: decline any fill worse than the quote by >3.0c

treatments.label: M10+M8 · execution guard + regime gate
treatments.rationale: decline bad fills AND stand down in bad regimes

treatments.label: M11 · maker limit (rest 2c below, fill or skip)
treatments.rationale: never cross the spread; fill only on price improvement

treatments.label: M11+M8 · maker limit + regime gate
treatments.rationale: the Ideal trader's execution core, SPRT-verified

treatments.label: M12 · EV-ranked leader (costs, not win rate)
treatments.rationale: follow the arm with the best trailing EV/$1 at real costs

treatments.label: M13 · edge band (enough edge, not too much)
treatments.rationale: enter only when claimed edge is 2-12c — a huge stated edge is a model-error signature, not opportunity
